request.note: Nubank runs 16B spans an hour through a Collector fleet. Load-balancing exporter by trace id, then tail sampling on errors and slow spans.
takeaways: Shard the Collector by trace id before tail sampling
Keep 100% of error traces, sample the rest
Budget memory per Collector pod and alert on refused spans
